title: Unit 7 — GP-07: Solving a Resistor Network
description: Use MATLAB to solve a three-node resistor network, check an independent known answer and current balance, and compare node voltages after a supply change. Follow the GP-07 Canvas page and video while completing the numbered TODOs.
note: All inputs are included. This is an ideal teaching circuit. Run the main script; the helper is called with inputs. Run Tests gives feedback and does not submit to Canvas.
